breadth.criterion: every mandatory atlas cell has primary authority coverage plus owner and verifier skills
breadth.observed: core plus three adversarial atlas extensions now model 36 explicit coverage cells; extension three adds cross-device action equivalence, accessibility settings, accessible media, and sign-language presentation, with another novelty sweep still required

depth.criterion: high-risk and high-drift domains use multiple independent primary sources where available
depth.observed: research now spans accessibility, AI, safety, platform, automotive, robotics, BCI, control-room, affective, avatar, AAC, cross-device actions, accessibility settings, captions/subtitles, spoken media alternatives, and sign-language presentation; final cross-domain depth review remains open

contradictions.criterion: conflicting standards or guidance are resolved by scope/authority or preserved as explicit alternatives
contradictions.observed: WCAG 3 remains draft while WCAG 2.2 remains the web conformance baseline; ISO draft versus published status is preserved; sign language is separated from AAC symbols and captions; platform visual trends remain contextual rather than universal

novelty.criterion: a final adversarial primary-source search wave adds no material new decision mechanism or uncovered mandatory domain class that cannot be decomposed into existing faculties
novelty.observed: the third sweep still discovered four non-decomposable decision classes, so saturation cannot yet be claimed; another sweep must challenge aviation/industrial/tangible/immersive-media/assistive-system boundaries and record whether findings decompose cleanly

freshness.criterion: high-drift sources have reviewed_at plus radar cadence
freshness.observed: high-drift standards, platform, AI, accessibility, BCI, avatar, affective, and sign-language sources are dated and tracked; drafts are not promoted to released requirements

reopen_conditions: new platform surface or input modality
new material specialist UI decision class
material AI or generative-UI standard change
new empirical evidence invalidates a mechanism
mandatory atlas cell becomes unowned or unverifiable
